extension.news: 3.0.6 - Add: broken or repeated definitions in the config files are reported, with the fix in the log - Add: property buttons take a heading for every dialog they open - Add: schema names are case-insensitive - Deprecated: title on property buttons, use heading instead; title will be removed in a future version - Deprecated: template_only, use templateOnly instead; template_only will be removed in a future version - Fix: widgets and backgrounds from skin items and menu defaults keep their path, label and type - Fix: custom widget menus add widgets and survive a submenu reset - Fix: a reset or restored item shows its widget and background straight away - Fix: closing a subdialog opens its menu without showing the main dialog first - Fix: items with a visible attribute show or hide when its result changes - Fix: digit-only labels and the id property are wrapped in $NUMBER - Fix: actor, director, studio and tag shortcuts open the right library list - Fix: icon overrides apply to shortcut groupings and grouped backgrounds - Fix: an allow element leaves unlisted features allowed - Fix: special:// paths work in the path and output arguments - Fix: a templates.xml with only submenu templates builds them - Fix: true/false attribute values are case-insensitive - Fix: addons content with a games target lists game add-ons - Misc fixes and improvements
